name: The Locked Mouth
summary: You can't be Charmed, and Advantage on Deception. The price: Disadvantage on Persuasion, -5 to passive Perception, and never again a true word about yourself.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: Your mind becomes a locked box. Nothing gets in to bend it, and nothing gets out you don't allow.

cost.flaw: You cannot say a true thing about yourself out loud. You can write it down, and then you must burn the page.
cost.text: A locked box hears very little. You stop listening to the world, and people stop believing you.
